options.text: The change from liquid to gas
The change from gas to liquid
The change from solid directly to gas, skipping the liquid state
The change from gas directly to solid

questions.explanation: Sublimation is the change of state from a solid directly to a gas without passing through the liquid state. Energy is absorbed during sublimation. Examples include dry ice (solid CO2) turning directly into carbon dioxide gas and solid iodine turning into iodine vapour.

questions.stem: Changes of state are physical changes. What does this mean?

options.text: New substances are formed that cannot be changed back
The particles themselves change into different types of atoms
No new substances are formed, the change is reversible, and only the arrangement of particles changes
Energy is always released during the change

questions.explanation: Changes of state are physical changes because no new substances are formed. The change is reversible (for example, water can be frozen and then melted back). Only the arrangement and movement of particles changes - the particles themselves remain the same. This is different from chemical changes where new substances are formed.
